headline: Devils’ Anthony Mantha to ‘miss some time’ with throat injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Devils forward Anthony Mantha will "miss some time" with a throat injury, and notes New Jersey dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen for its game in Toronto on Sunday.

The loss is real but not a crisis. Mantha has 10 points in 17 games so far this season, scoring five goals on 4.0 expected goals (the number of goals his chances should have produced), so he's running slightly hot. He plays 13.5 minutes a night, and the Devils have generated a bit less offense with him on the ice than without, by about 1.3 points of expected goal share. The team itself is strong: 12-5-0, with 59 percent of the expected goals. The weak spot is goaltending, where the group sits at minus 7.2 goals saved above expected so far this season.

Mantha has played every game so far, so we have no sample of the Devils without him. Going by how the coach has used his players, Connor Brown, at 14:26 a night, is next in line for his minutes. Mike Fink of The Hockey News posted that it will be interesting to see how Keefe handles the wing spot.
